name: subagent-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate implementation and review work through dispatched workers — Codex CLI (GPT-5.6) and Claude subagents — with a task-strategy workflow, model routing, fenced write scopes, and independent two-worker verification. Extendable at five workflow positions and via recognized named configuration values; the plugin ships hooks that deliver a project's extension file (.claude/extensions/subagent-orchestrator/) wrapped in a structural envelope
